SELECT poi.order_sn, CASE WHEN pp.is_combo = 1 THEN pp.sku ELSE poi.sku END AS sku, CASE WHEN pp.is_combo = 1 THEN COALESCE(pp.product_name, poi.product_name) ELSE poi.product_name END AS product_name, po.status_text, po.supplier_name, po.ware_house_name, po.opt_realname, pp.quantity_plan, poi.quantity_real, poi.quantity_entry, j.plan_sn, po.create_time, CASE WHEN pp.is_combo = 1 AND pp.sku = poi.sku THEN '组合采' WHEN pp.is_combo = 1 AND pp.sku <> poi.sku THEN '单品采' ELSE NULL END AS purchase_mode, CASE WHEN j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND pp.is_combo = 1 AND pp.sku <> poi.sku THEN '套装' WHEN j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND pp.is_combo IN (0, 1) THEN '单品' ELSE '合并下单' END AS ptype, AS group_key, CASE WHEN poi.quantity_real IS NOT NULL AND poi.quantity_entry IS NOT NULL AND poi.quantity_entry >= poi.quantity_real THEN -1 WHEN po.status_text = '已完成' THEN -1 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, po.create_time, NOW()) END AS risk FROM lx_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN lx_purchase_order po ON po.order_sn = poi.order_sn LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(poi.relation_purchase_plan, '$[*]' COLUMNS (plan_sn VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) AS j ON j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND j.plan_sn <> '' LEFT JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = j.plan_sn WHERE poi.is_delete = 0 AND po.status NOT IN (-1, 124)

sql.if: AND ( poi.order_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR poi.plan_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR j.plan_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR po.supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR po.opt_realname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR po.ware_house_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR poi.sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR poi.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.sql: GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ptype) = '合并下单' AND COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT plan_sn), '') = ''

SELECT group_key, CASE WHEN () THEN '单品' WHEN GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ptype) = '单品' AND ( COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(sku), '')) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(plan_sn), '')) > 1 ) THEN '合并下单' ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ptype) END AS type, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN purchase_mode = '组合采' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN '组合采' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN purchase_mode = '单品采' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN '单品采' ELSE NULL END AS purchase_mode, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product_name ORDER BY product_name SEPARATOR '、') AS product_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sku ORDER BY sku SEPARATOR '、') AS sku, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(sku), '')) AS sku_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT order_sn) AS orders, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT plan_sn) AS plans, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT opt_realname) AS opt_names, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT supplier_name) AS suppliers, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ware_house_name) AS warehouses, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT status_text) AS status_text, IF((), SUM(quantity_real), MAX(quantity_plan)) AS qty_plan, IF((), SUM(quantity_entry), IF(SUM(quantity_real) = SUM(quantity_entry), MAX(quantity_plan), 0)) AS qty_ready, MAX(risk) AS risk, MIN(create_time) AS created_time FROM ( ) t INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT group_key AS matched_group_key FROM ( ) matched_rows ) matched_groups ON matched_groups.matched_group_key = t.group_key GROUP BY t.group_key

ORDER BY g.risk DESC, g.created_time ASC, g.group_key ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk >= 0 AND risk < 240 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk >= 240 AND risk < 360 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS due_soon_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN risk >= 360 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(plans, '') = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS manual_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN FIND_IN_SET('套装', type) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS kit_count FROM ( ) g WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT t.end_time FROM lx_sync_task t WHERE t.task_type = 'order' AND t.status = 'success' AND t.end_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.end_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT supplier_name FROM lx_purchase_order WHERE supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND supplier_name != '' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND status NOT IN (-1, 124) ORDER BY supplier_name
SELECT DISTINCT opt_realname FROM lx_purchase_order WHERE opt_realname IS NOT NULL AND opt_realname != '' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND status NOT IN (-1, 124) ORDER BY opt_realname
SELECT DISTINCT ware_house_name FROM lx_purchase_order WHERE ware_house_name IS NOT NULL AND ware_house_name != '' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND status NOT IN (-1, 124) ORDER BY ware_house_name

SELECT poi.id AS component_id, MAX(poi.sku) AS sku, MAX(poi.product_name) AS product_name, MAX(poi.order_sn) AS order_sn, MAX(j.plan_sn) AS plan_sn, AS purchase_mode, MAX(po.supplier_name) AS supplier_name, MAX(po.ware_house_name) AS ware_house_name, MAX(po.opt_realname) AS opt_realname, MAX(pp.quantity_plan) AS quantity_plan, MAX(poi.quantity_entry) AS quantity_entry, MAX(poi.quantity_real) AS expected_qty, MAX(poi.quantity_qc) AS qualified_qty, MAX(poi.quantity_return) AS returned_qty, MAX(poi.quantity_exchange) AS exchange_qty, MAX(po.status_text) AS status_text, MAX( CASE WHEN poi.quantity_real IS NOT NULL AND poi.quantity_entry IS NOT NULL AND poi.quantity_entry >= poi.quantity_real THEN -1 WHEN po.status_text = '已完成' THEN -1 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, po.create_time, NOW()) END ) AS risk FROM lx_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN lx_purchase_order po ON po.order_sn = poi.order_sn LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(poi.relation_purchase_plan, '$[*]' COLUMNS (plan_sn VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) AS j ON j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND j.plan_sn <> '' LEFT JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = j.plan_sn WHERE poi.is_delete = 0 AND po.status NOT IN (-1, 124)
GROUP BY poi.id ORDER BY risk DESC, MIN(po.create_time) ASC, MAX(poi.sku) ASC

SELECT AS group_key, COALESCE( NULLIF( GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND pp.is_combo = 1 THEN COALESCE(pp.product_name, poi.product_name) ELSE poi.product_name END ORDER BY CASE WHEN j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND pp.is_combo = 1 THEN COALESCE(pp.product_name, poi.product_name) ELSE poi.product_name END SEPARATOR '、' ), '' ), #{groupKey} ) AS product_name FROM lx_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN lx_purchase_order po ON po.order_sn = poi.order_sn LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(poi.relation_purchase_plan, '$[*]' COLUMNS (plan_sn VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) AS j ON j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND j.plan_sn <> '' LEFT JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = j.plan_sn WHERE poi.is_delete = 0 AND po.status NOT IN (-1, 124) AND () = #{groupKey} GROUP BY

SELECT poi.id AS component_id, MAX(poi.sku) AS sku, MAX(poi.product_name) AS product_name, MAX(poi.order_sn) AS order_sn, MAX(j.plan_sn) AS plan_sn, AS purchase_mode, MAX(po.supplier_name) AS supplier_name, MAX(po.ware_house_name) AS ware_house_name, MAX(po.opt_realname) AS opt_realname, MAX(pp.quantity_plan) AS quantity_plan, MAX(poi.quantity_entry) AS quantity_entry, MAX(poi.quantity_real) AS expected_qty, MAX(poi.quantity_qc) AS qualified_qty, MAX(poi.quantity_return) AS returned_qty, MAX(poi.quantity_exchange) AS exchange_qty, MAX(po.status_text) AS status_text, MAX( CASE WHEN poi.quantity_real IS NOT NULL AND poi.quantity_entry IS NOT NULL AND poi.quantity_entry >= poi.quantity_real THEN -1 WHEN po.status_text = '已完成' THEN -1 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, po.create_time, NOW()) END ) AS risk FROM lx_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN lx_purchase_order po ON po.order_sn = poi.order_sn LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(poi.relation_purchase_plan, '$[*]' COLUMNS (plan_sn VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) AS j ON j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND j.plan_sn <> '' LEFT JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = j.plan_sn WHERE poi.id = #{componentId} AND poi.is_delete = 0 AND po.status NOT IN (-1, 124)
GROUP BY poi.id

SELECT bl.id, grouped_order.order_sn, bl.ol_time AS event_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(bl.ol_type_text, ''), '操作记录') AS title, COALESCE(bl.ol_detail, '') AS description, bl.realname AS operator FROM lx_business_log bl INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT poi.order_sn FROM lx_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN lx_purchase_order po ON po.order_sn = poi.order_sn LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(poi.relation_purchase_plan, '$[*]' COLUMNS (plan_sn VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) AS j ON j.plan_sn IS NOT NULL AND j.plan_sn <> '' LEFT JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = j.plan_sn WHERE poi.is_delete = 0 AND po.status NOT IN (-1, 124) AND () = #{groupKey} ) grouped_order ON bl.business_id = CONCAT('1_', grouped_order.order_sn) ORDER BY bl.ol_time ASC, bl.id ASC

SELECT bl.id, #{orderSn} AS order_sn, bl.ol_time AS event_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(bl.ol_type_text, ''), '操作记录') AS title, COALESCE(bl.ol_detail, '') AS description, bl.realname AS operator FROM lx_business_log bl WHERE bl.business_id = CONCAT('1_', #{orderSn}) ORDER BY bl.ol_time ASC, bl.id ASC
